create_PyTorchClassifier: create a PyTorchClassifier with input dimension, number of classes, and L2 regularization
build_MLP_classifier: build an MLP or Logistic Regression classifier with configurable hidden units, dropout, and optimizer
fit_classifier_model: fit the classifier model on training data with validation split and early stopping
score_classifier_accuracy: score the classifier accuracy on held-out validation data
predict_classifier_labels: predict class labels from the trained classifier on new input data
